about: Column mappings the publishers of some sample tables state, read by `cargo xtask logs` through `hpr_flightdata::generic::read_with` (M7.1c15, ADR-270). Each maps a file, by id (the first 16 hex digits of its SHA-256), whose header names its clock with no unit; a column the publisher doesn't map is kept as written. RocketPy (MIT) reads each of these files in the example notebook for its flight (`docs/examples/`, commit 9bd6ad3) with FlightDataImporter, whose docstring defines units=None as every column in SI (`rocketpy/simulation/flight_data_importer.py`); its altitude is above ground level (`Flight.altitude`), its vz and az the vertical velocity and acceleration in the inertial frame (`Flight.vz`, `Flight.az`).
